message.content: Build TruthOps: autonomous trust operations agent for neatHack 2026. Investigates high-risk corporate claims against primary sources, challenges findings via contrarian review, produces evidence-backed response plans with human approval gates.
Scaffolded TruthOps repo at ~/workspace/truthops. Implemented director, evidence pipeline, claims engine, contrarian review, and response planner. Northstar synthetic case created for testing.
Add GPTZero AI detection as validation signal for secondary sources. Also integrate Firecrawl for live evidence retrieval.

Implemented GPTZero adapter (truthops/evidence/gptzero_adapter.py) wrapping gptzero-scan CLI. Annotation-only: never changes verdicts. Firecrawl adapter live with hackathon key. Northstar run: MISLEADING verdict confirmed.
Add a cheap sniff test gate before the full $1.08 pipeline. Obvious fakes without traction should stop early.

Implemented truthops/sniff_test.py with heuristic backend. Cloudflare Clef-flash pluggable via Workers AI. Verified: Northstar proceeds, 'moon is cheese' rejected, fake with traction proceeds. Wired into director.
Expand GPTZero to use all four signals: AI detection, paraphrased, sentence-level, plagiarism.
Expanded adapter to extract ai_paraphrased subclass, sentence-level flagged sentences, plagiarism (null in v2 API). Tested: p_ai=1.0 correctly flagged AI text with 3 flagged sentences.
Link cfo.ai to live GPTZero API. Build a hosted MCP server.

Built GPTZero MCP server as Cloudflare Worker, deployed to SpaceFast at https://gptzero-mcp.space.fast/mcp. Tools: detect_ai, detect_paraphrased, flagged_sentences. Live API verified. Corrected financial model to $45/mo ($1.08/investigation).
Keep pushing. Also check Entire support for checkpoints.

Regression passed (MISLEADING). Pushed 3 commits via Git Data API. Updated README with architecture and sponsor evidence. Found Entire's Discord, posted support question. Discovered BYO agent plugin path via Alexandria.
